required_regressions.concurrent_preparation: Independent processes resolve equivalent initial intents and canonical retry aliases to one attempt; concurrent claims yield one permit.
required_regressions.lost_acknowledgement: Injected post-COMMIT failures preserve publication and claim identity across reopen; replay never returns a second permit.
required_regressions.proven_non_admission: Trusted outcome can refine a prior issued observation, but the consumed intent is never reopened.
required_regressions.unknown_execution: Missing acknowledgement remains unknown; fake decisions and decisions lacking unresolved-prior authorization cannot redispatch.
required_regressions.canonical_authorized_retry: A fixture-owned durable decision binds original request and predecessor; canonical aliases share one additional permit.
required_regressions.same_retry_decision_replay: The same canonical decision and every alias return the existing attempt, including after reopen.
required_regressions.historical_revision: A remains readable and claimable after B; original mandate.currentness alone activates stale-work rejection.
required_regressions.recovery: Real v1 migration preserves original bytes/schema; failed migration rolls back. Closed and killed-writer residual-WAL backup/restore preserve namespace, consumed intent and authorized public readback.
required_regressions.readback_authority: Native permission is checked on each production operation; ownership is rechecked; unrelated Sessions and same-requester native read revocation deny private results.

findings: Existing question dispatch has no durable canonical retry decision.
OQ answers do not grant permission.
Native permission.assert does not return a durable request-and-predecessor-bound retry authorization.
retry_authority.test_authority: Fixture-owned durable SQLite authorization decisions; proves arbitration mechanics only.
retry_authority.product_decision: May an existing admission/dispatch owner issue a durable, uniquely identified retry decision under the original authorization after trusted non-admission, and which accepted policy or host evidence authorizes that act?
retry_authority.unknown_prior: A separate established decision must explicitly account for the unresolved predecessor; no automatic retry.
